prompts.metaPdfAcquisition:
Use $meta-zotero-fulltext-handoff to push missing Meta full text to Zotero. First read the current full-text-stage 04_full_text_review/fulltext_manifest.json/csv, downloaded/parsed full-text assets; read ZOTERO_API_KEY, ZOTERO_USER_ID, MEDHELP_API_BASE_URL, and MEDHELP_API_TOKEN/MEDHELP_AUTHORIZATION from the current environment first, and do not ask the user to manually generate a JWT when those env vars exist; update the gap list from records that still lack usable full text, then push those gap records to Zotero so Zotero can obtain or attach PDFs. Prefer exporting a RIS reference-management file first, then import that RIS into Zotero; if RIS import fails, pause automatic handoff immediately and switch to manual import instructions plus the RIS file, without trying other automatic import paths. Do not treat title/abstract AI second screen as a hard prerequisite and do not frame this as full-text second screening; this is a full-text-stage gap-fill and availability-screening step. Do not run broad web downloads; except for the RIS-failure manual fallback, do not ask the AI to generate large manual-import files.

metaAnalysis.title: Meta-analysis
metaAnalysis.description: Run a PRISMA-oriented Meta workflow: literature, protocol, multi-pass AI screening, PDF/MinerU, data extraction, quality assessment, synthesis, figures, manuscript, and presentation.

paperWriting.title: Medical Manuscript Writing
paperWriting.description: Structure sections and claims; use nature-data for Data Availability statements, repository plans, dataset citations, and FAIR metadata checks; use citation-management to organize/validate citations & references; after drafting, use the "Manuscript polishing" shortcut for Nature-style edits and humanized phrasing.

paperPolishing.title: Manuscript Polishing
paperPolishing.description: Refine near-final prose: nature-polishing for Nature-leaning English and flow; inno-humanizer for natural, less AI-templated phrasing; optionally scientific-writing, citation-management, and venue-templates for the target venue.

manuscriptReview.title: Medical Paper Review
manuscriptReview.description: Reviewer-style checks plus interpreting findings, clinical impact, limitations, and narrative framing.

rebuttalResponse.title: Rebuttal & causal/sensitivity
rebuttalResponse.description: Respond to reviewers; strengthen confounding control, robustness, alternate definitions, and causal framing.

presentationPromotion.title: Academic Presentation & Translation
presentationPromotion.description: Slides and lab-meeting materials; or narration scripts, audio, and demo video assets.

pipeline.title: Start Meta Pipeline
pipeline.description: Generate the Meta research brief, task queue, directory rules, and first execution step across the review workflow.

literature.title: Literature
literature.description: Evidence gaps, search scope, seed references, and evidence synthesis.

ideation.title: Topic framing
ideation.description: Evaluate clinical relevance, evidence volume, heterogeneity risk, extractable effects, and submission value.

scopingReview.title: Scoping / systematic review
scopingReview.description: Evidence mapping, systematic review design, narrative synthesis, and PRISMA counts without forcing pooled statistics.

protocol.title: Protocol / PICO
protocol.description: Review type, PICO/PECO, eligibility criteria, and PRISMA logic.

searchDedupe.title: Search / dedupe
searchDedupe.description: Queries, logs, imported records, dedupe, and candidate reference sheets.

screeningPdf.title: AI Screening / Full Text
screeningPdf.description: AI first-screen scoring, Claude AI second screen, at most one catch-up audit, full-text candidates, full-text upload, and legal-source audit.

pdfAcquisition.title: Zotero Communication
pdfAcquisition.description: Use the current full-text-stage gap list and local asset status to import only records still missing usable full text into Zotero via RIS first; pause automatic handoff and switch to manual import if RIS import fails.

manualScreening.title: Title/abstract first screen
manualScreening.description: Read deduped candidate records and produce title/abstract AI first-screen decisions plus the AI second-screen queue.

titleAbstractScreening.title: Title screening
titleAbstractScreening.description: Handle title/abstract first screen and AI second screen from one entry point, including decisions, conflicts, exclusion reasons, include/maybe records, and catch-up candidates.

fullTextDownload.title: Full-text Download
fullTextDownload.description: Process only needs_full_text=true records with incomplete local full text from fulltext_manifest, use available download skills to obtain PDF/HTML/Markdown/text from public sources, and record failure reasons.

titleAbstractFirstScreen.title: Title/abstract first screen
titleAbstractFirstScreen.description: Read deduped candidate records and produce title/abstract AI first-screen decisions plus the AI second-screen queue.

titleAbstractSecondScreen.title: Title/abstract AI second screen
